lines.text: At Antioch, the Holy Spirit tells the prophets and teachers to set apart Barnabas and Saul, and they lay hands on them.
Sent by the Holy Spirit, Barnabas and Saul sail from Seleucia to Crete and proclaim God's word in Salamis synagogues.
At Paphos, the proconsul Sergius Paulus wants to hear God's word, but the sorcerer Elymas tries to turn him from the faith.
Filled with the Holy Spirit, Paul tells Elymas he will be blind forever, and mist and darkness come over him.
When the proconsul sees what happened, he believes, astonished at the teaching about the Lord.
